The '''Scabaras apparition''' is an apparition of the god [[Scabaras]] and is fought during [[Icthlarin's Little Helper]] if the [[canopic jar of Scabaras]] is picked up.

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Magic ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=hidden|update=Forinthry Frontier, Ninja Strike, Game Jam! - This Week In RuneScape|date=27 February 2022}}
** Renamed from "Scabaras" to "Scabaras apparition".

* {{UL|type=hidden|update=Patch Notes (16 January 2017)|date=16 January 2017}}
** The patchy skin of Scabaras's manifestation has been fixed.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Desert Month Finale|date=26 April 2005}}
** Added to game.
}}

==Trivia==
* Like all of the apparitions of demigods in Icthlarin's Little Helper, Scabaras appears to be wearing something similar to a [[diamond necklace]] with a darker gem.
